title: Compact form: define prefix/suffix layout, inline-help rules, and validation layering
text:
Compact form: define prefix/suffix layout, inline-help rules, and validation layering

description:
Scope: Normalize compact form field behaviors (text inputs, selects, toggles) when using prefixes/suffixes, inline help text, and multi-tier validation messages. Goal is to produce a clear token mapping, responsive layouts for density modes, and a migration guide for existing components. This ticket focuses on layout rules and visual hierarchy rather than implementation details; follow-up ENG tickets will implement the code changes.

comments:
2025-01-10 - Asha Patel: Kickoff — observed multiple inconsistent designs across products: prefixed currency inputs that break vertical rhythm in compact lists, selects with long suffix chips pushing labels, and validation messages that compete with inline helper text. Captured examples from Console, Dedicated onboarding, and SDK key flow.
2025-01-13 - Miguel Hernandez: Reviewed examples; initial list of pain points added to doc. Proposed constraints: max two inline affordances (prefix, suffix), suffix content should truncate with tooltip; helper text limited to single line in compact mode with ellipsis and expandable detail view.
2025-01-16 - Design critique: Attendees — Asha, Miguel, Priya Rao (PM), James Li (ENG infra). Feedback: ensure keyboard focus order remains predictable when inline controls (clear, reveal) are present; toggles used as small inline switches require different hit target guidance in compact density.
2025-01-20 - Decision: Adopt hierarchical message layering — priority order: field-level error > field-level warning > inline helper > secondary hint. Only one visible message slot in compact density; errors override helper text and push helper to collapsed state accessible via icon.
2025-01-24 - Token proposal snapshot uploaded to Confluence and Figma: updated spacing tokens (compact-input-vertical, compact-affordance-gap), typography adjustments for helper text (12px semibold for error, 11px regular for helper), and z-index rules for dropdowns vs tooltips. Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DS/Compact+Forms+Tokens
2025-01-28 - Engineering sync: James Li requested explicit examples for KV cache UX when inputs stream suggestions — decided that dropdown suggestion width will match visual input boundary, not the full container, to avoid horizontal overflow in compact lists. Added acceptance criteria for truncation and tooltip behavior.
2025-01-30 - Accessibility review (Anna Kim): Recommended using aria-describedby to link message slot to input; collapsed helper detail must be reachable via keyboard and announced with aria-expanded when toggled. Also requested contrast check on error text in compact density — results posted in Confluence.
2025-02-02 - PM note (Priya Rao): This change affects onboarding forms and billing flows (high-visibility). Proposed feature flag and migration runway; prioritize migration guide and a small AB test to verify no regression in form completion rate.
2025-02-03 - Miguel Hernandez: Drafted migration checklist and implementation notes for ENG: identify components with custom CSS overrides, update token references, ensure storybook regression suite includes snapshot for density modes, and add keyboard tests for inline affordances. PR to follow (ENG-PR-3421).
